title: Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam website
lede: The museum’s home page stacks its name and its programme as full-width lines of very large grotesque capitals between heavy black rules.
summary: Huge black grotesque capitals in full-width bands between heavy rules, with one flat green button.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 25 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens. A cookie notice covers part of the lower right quarter of the screenshot.

styles.note: A clear example: grotesque type at extreme scale, flush left, in black and white with one flat accent, organized in horizontal bands. It passes every fingerprint metric.

observed: The word STEDELIJK fills the full width of the page in very large black grotesque capitals.
A tilted yellow sticker with the word “Unbubble” in a heavy rounded display face overlaps the last letters of the name.
Below it, “MUSEUM OF MODERN AND CONTEMPORARY ART AND DESIGN” is set in one line of smaller capitals.
Heavy black horizontal rules divide the page into bands. Each band holds one line of large capitals, such as “WHAT’S ON: EXHIBITIONS &” and “YAYOI KUSAMA”, cut off at the right edge.
One small square photograph sits inside a band next to the word NEW.
The only flat color in the interface is a bright green “Book ticket” button at the top right.
interpretation: The measurement finds one grotesque family (Union) for 98% of the text, square corners, no shadows, two CSS colors, a size range of 3.47, and 52% uppercase text.
The yellow sticker is an exhibition campaign placed on top of the identity, not part of the grid. It is the one element that breaks the style.
borrow: Treat a list of exhibitions as a stack of full-width type bands separated by heavy rules.
Keep one accent color for the one action that matters (here, tickets).

images.alt: Stedelijk Museum home page: the word STEDELIJK in huge black grotesque capitals across the top with a tilted yellow Unbubble sticker, then full-width bands of large capitals reading What’s on, Yayoi Kusama, and Kho Liang Ie between heavy black rules, a green Book ticket button, and a black cookie notice at the lower right.
images.caption: First viewport of [stedelijk.nl](https://www.stedelijk.nl/en).
